mapper.select: select * from t_showing where cinema_id=#{cinemaId} order by id desc

select s.id, s.cinema_id as cinemaId, c.name as cinemaName, s.hall_id as hallId, h.name as hallName, s.movie_id as movieId, m.name as movieName, m.poster_url as moviePosterUrl, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, s.ticket_price as ticketPrice, s.audit_status as auditStatus from t_showing s join t_cinema c on c.id = s.cinema_id join t_hall h on h.id = s.hall_id join t_movie m on m.id = s.movie_id where s.cinema_id=#{cinemaId} order by s.id desc
mapper.update: update t_showing set hall_id=#{hallId}, movie_id=#{movieId}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, ticket_price=#{ticketPrice}, updated_time=now() where id=#{id}
